children: Truist has initiated a Buy rating for MiniMed Group
, saying that the company has benefited from increased investment following years of under-investment by Medtronic
, a better business strategy, and new launches.
The bank has a $29 price target (~41% upside based on Sept. 23 close).

Truist believes that MiniMed is in a position to maintain and possibly increase its share in segments of insulin intensive diabetes (IIT), including automated IIT insulin delivery, tubeless/patch pumps, and its Simplera continuous glucose monitor. It also benefits from a CGM partnership with Abbott Laboratories

Analyst Richard Newitter said that the stock is currently trading at an attractive entry, adding that MiniMed is "an increasingly profitable 'full-stack' diabetes biz we see capable of sustaining a 10% rev CAGR & pot'l to double EPS in 2 yrs."

He added that he has been “impressed” with CEO Que Dellara, adding, "As a stand-alone, MMED is freer to focus investments and mgmt.'s time on executing for key diabetes growth engines & profit drivers."

title: MiniMed a new Buy at Truist on turnaround following Medtronic split
